SELECT
    d.IsWorkDay,
    sum(s.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales,
    round(100.0 * sum(s.SalesAmount) / sum(sum(s.SalesAmount)) OVER (), 2) AS SalesPct,
    count() AS TransactionCount,
    round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS TransactionPct
FROM retail.FactSales s
JOIN retail.DimDate d ON s.DateKey = d.DateKey
GROUP BY d.IsWorkDay
ORDER BY d.IsWorkDay
